dimensions.assessment: Applies primarily to the Small Business Administration's Office of Inspector General and congressional committees.
dimensions.evidence: Inspector General of the Small Business Administration shall submit to the Committee on Small Business of the House... and... Senate

dimensions.assessment: Administrative reporting requirement without new substantive enforcement or lending authorities.
dimensions.evidence: report on the number of borrowers engaged in fraud with respect to a covered loan

dimensions.assessment: Explicitly states that no funds are authorized to be appropriated to carry out the act.
dimensions.evidence: No such funds are authorized to be appropriated to carry out this Act.

dimensions.assessment: Creates a temporary reporting mandate for a specific set of federal loans.
dimensions.evidence: submit to the Committee on Small Business... a report on the number of borrowers engaged in fraud

dimensions.assessment: Temporary mandate terminating two years after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: terminate on the date that is two years after the date of the enactment of this Act.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill mandates quarterly reporting from the Small Business Administration's Inspector General regarding COVID-19 loan fraud for a period of two years.
